title: Chinese spy balloon as standard of evidence

tellings.quote: Much like the Chinese spy balloon that floated over US airspace in 2023. Everybody sees it.

plain: The skeptic Michael Shermer holds up the Chinese spy balloon that drifted over the United States in 2023 as the kind of evidence UFO claims should be able to match. As he puts it to Michels, "Everybody sees it": a real object in the sky gets seen, photographed and agreed on by everyone. The point is that if strange craft were really flying around, they should be just as plain to see.
